Envelope approach

Mineral-wool cavities, continuous exterior insulation, an interior air/vapour control layer and a drained, ventilated rainscreen are the proposed wall strategy. Timber bridges, seams, wind washing and drying must be analysed together. The displayed plywood skin is structural sheathing, not a finished weather barrier.

The roof deck is shown flat for comparison only. Drainage falls, roof build-up, fire protection, ground moisture separation and foundations remain unresolved. A ventilation system is required for an airtight habitable design. Neither height setting establishes habitation or Lithuanian compliance.
